description: Northern Ireland Railways Platforms is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. A Northern Ireland Railways Platform is defined as a structure that provides, or originally provided, access for passengers to trains at a station or halt, or for loading onto or unloading goods from a train. The term includes associated front and rear walls, cross walls, elevated or suspended spans or supports. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are Government, Halt, INSPIRE, Metadata, NI. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2023-04-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
